claims.assertion: Athena says incarnated partners need not be the same versions across lives; compatibility can join different fragments of a shared higher consciousness.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: She says past-life memories may differ between partners, and some apparent memories can map shared future experiences rather than past ones.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She says broad memory differences are uncommon.

claims.assertion: Athena attributes perceived repeating-life loops to attachments; releasing them dissolves loops and lets people form their future.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: Her account links loops to forgotten past-life causes.
